from collections import deque

def components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=grid[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells={(r,c)}
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop()
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); cells.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color,cells))
    return out

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    comps=components(grid); h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    edge=[(color,cells) for color,cells in comps if color!=bg and any(r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1) for r,c in cells)]
    inner=[(color,cells) for color,cells in comps if color!=bg and not any(r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1) for r,c in cells)]
    # An edge object gives the replacement color for an equally sized interior object.
    for color,cells in inner:
        matches=[(ec,es) for ec,es in edge if len(es)==len(cells)]
        if matches:
            for ec,_ in matches:
                for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=ec
            break
    return out
